```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(brandkit)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
brand_quarto_setup()
```

## Branded Presentation

Colours, fonts, and styling come from `_brand.yml`.

All ggplot2 and plotly output is auto-themed.

## Static Plot

```{r}
#| label: scatter
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4
ggplot(mtcars, aes(mpg, wt, color = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(title = "MPG vs Weight", color = "Cylinders")
```

## Interactive Plotly

```{r}
#| label: plotly
p <- ggplot(iris, aes(Sepal.Length, Sepal.Width, color = Species)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(title = "Iris — Hover for Details")

brand_plotly(p, tooltip = c("x", "y", "colour"), width = 1000, height = 600)
```

## Palette Overview

```{r}
#| label: palette
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 3
cols <- brand_pal_discrete(n = 8)
barplot(rep(1, length(cols)), col = cols, border = NA, axes = FALSE,
        main = "Brand discrete palette")
```

## Dark Mode Slides

Set `brand-mode: dark` in the YAML header to render
the entire deck using your dark palette:

```yaml
format:
  revealjs:
    brand-mode: dark
```

And update the setup chunk:

```r
brand_quarto_setup("dark")
```
